pages.title: Real Item Resources
pages.text: True Power and Immortal Power are normal items. Storage, crafting, villagers and other mods can read them. Any stage cap counts player plus personal storage; True Power becomes uncapped after stage six.
One Immortal Power crafts into 64 True Power. True Power smelts 10 items and Immortal Power smelts 500.

Stage ten generates 256 Immortal Power every 20 ticks by default with uncapped storage. Servers may enable a non-consuming channel. Placed Power makes a dyeable light core; Immortal Power also suppresses hostile natural spawning in its current chunk.
